ai_summary.key_headline: Czech Physicality and Crossing Power Faces Technical Bafana Bafana

czech_republic.philosophy: Direct vertical play focusing on aerial duels and high-volume crossing.

south_africa.philosophy: High-tempo technical passing with a structured low-block transition focus.

tactical_insights: Tomas Soucek's late runs into the box will test South Africa's youthful central defense.
South Africa will rely on Teboho Mokoena's progressive passing to bypass the aggressive Czech mid-block.
Czech Republic's height advantage on set-pieces will be a primary avenue for goalscoring opportunities.
